blocker: Sizing concern (attribute line kept verbatim per hard rule, NOT edited): ecdsa_verify is heavy (128-bit GLV 4x scalar-mul, ~127 double-and-adds with modular inversions); the upstream example used heap_size=100000, max_trace_length=262144, whereas the frozen template pins heap_size=32768, max_trace_length=65536, so full-signature vectors may exceed max_trace_length at emulation time. Also requires host-side inline registration: added jolt-inlines-secp256k1 with features=["host"] to host/Cargo.toml so the tracer's inventory-based find_inline does not panic on opcode 0x0B .insn instructions.
decode_layout: 160 bytes = 20 little-endian u64. z=[u64;4] bytes 0..32; r=[u64;4] bytes 32..64; s=[u64;4] bytes 64..96; q=[u64;8] bytes 96..160 (public-key point x[u64;4] then y[u64;4]). Each [u64;N] is N consecutive LE u64 limbs, limb0 least-significant. input.len()<160 => empty Vec (total decode). Output: 1 byte, 1=Ok (valid signature), 0=Err (verification failed).
entry_called: jolt_inlines_secp256k1::ecdsa_verify(z, r, s, q) after Secp256k1Fr::from_u64_arr / Secp256k1Point::from_u64_arr validation (unwrap_or_spoil_proof)
